brief.title: You Get Your Beast's Power… Mine Was EMBARRASSING 😳 #shorts #roblox
brief.ruleLine: "In this world, you get whatever power your *beast* has." (7 words after the comma)
brief.palette: warm timber, slate blue, moss green, lantern amber. Each beast owns ONE glow colour (cyan · yellow · orange · amber · molten · Tuft blue-gold). Nothing else in the world uses Tuft's blue-gold
brief.colourScript: hook (0–2.2) night, blue-gold glow over dark roofs · act 1 (2.2–43) bright late-morning day, saturated · act 2 (43–70) storm-blue night → festival dusk amber · act 3 (70–94) dark storm + the Titan's molten orange; twist (81) Tuft's blue-gold floods the frame; colossal (89) brightest blue-gold of the act · payoff (96.7) warm lantern gold + Tuft glow, the brightest key of the episode
brief.setting: a hillside BEAST VILLAGE (our own design): timber-frame houses, slate-blue roofs, mossy stone walls, lantern strings, a school with tall windows; the TITAN'S MOUNTAIN with a dark cave mouth looms over every exterior (landmark; story plant)

payoff.shows: shot 59. Juni hugs Tuft, then the hero, under the lantern sea; the push settles on Nightfang asleep behind our house
payoff.hold length: from "hugs" to the next cut (≥ 1.5 s)
payoff.light: brightest key of the episode (payoffEV), warm lantern gold + Tuft's blue-gold rim; the hero's jacket stays within ΔE 12 of its charcoal
